appearance_facts.fact: The chart is titled 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'. The title text explicitly states 'Increasing'.
A single blue line plots production values for each year from 2018 to 2023.
The line begins at a value of 2,800 on the y-axis.
The line drops to a local minimum of 2,400.
The line rises to the highest point on the graph, slightly above the 2,800 grid line (approx 2,850).
The line drops to a value just below the 2,600 grid line (approx 2,580).
The line remains nearly flat, at a level visually identical to the 2021 point.
The line ends with a very slight decline from 2022, finishing just below the 2,600 grid line (approx 2,550).

printed_facts.fact: Labeled 'Production' with a scale from 0 to 3,000 in increments of 200.
Labeled 'Year' with tick marks for 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.

public_definitions: Goal: Review the Factory F production dashboard for the 2018-2023 operations record, then choose the follow-up route for the output trend.
Options: Route to output stability response, Route to output growth response, Route to output decline response.
uncertain: The chart title says 'Increasing Production', but the visual data shows a decrease from the 2020 peak to the 2023 end point.
